name: enquiry
title: Ask the house (enquiry)
description: The Casa Exemplo enquiry form rebuilt from library parts: a native form the browser validates, ruled fields that ink as you type, notes in the house's own words, a still line drawing of the house's front elevation in warm and playful, and a send that says plainly it is a prototype and sends nothing. Without JavaScript it validates natively and posts to a page that keeps nothing.
